title: TICKET-007-UNSLOTH-INSTALL — Unsloth + mlx-lm benchmark on Mac Mini M4
rationale: Install unsloth (FAILED — xformers/OpenMP incompatible with macOS clang). Benchmark mlx-lm as alternative. Results: mlx 3.14 TFLOPS matmul, 18.5ms/step LoRA training at qwen3-14B dims. Recommendation: mlx-lm is the correct fine-tuning stack for Mac M4.

tasks.description: Attempt unsloth install — FAILED due to xformers OpenMP incompatibility on macOS
Benchmark mlx matmul and LoRA training simulation at qwen3-14B dimensions
